comment: The four revert-checks of `fix-status-label-replacement` (tasks 5.1-5.4) as a runnable set: one mutation per invariant, the named case must go red, the file is restored, the case must go green again. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/status-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how, `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule, and the CI step that owns the issue tooling prints `--list`, so a set that no longer parses fails the pipeline instead of rotting. Every search is a single line and unique in its file (the runner's replacement is literal and line-based), which is what the transcript in `openspec/changes/archive/*-fix-status-label-replacement/evidence/revert-check.md` records.

mutations.why: the displaced state labels being read from the item, so the add and the removals ride one edit
the difference-only rule — a state write does not add the label the item already carries

mutations.search: issues_die "update: $status_named_as and --label $label name two states — a state write sets one" ;;
mutations.why: a call naming two states being refused instead of silently resolved
the report carrying the displaced labels the caller never named
a state named as the namespaced label being the same act as one named through the state flag
